1.title: Choose to Sponsor
1.text: Decide to sponsor one child (or more) for PKR 30,000 a month.

2.title: Transfer Monthly
2.text: Send your sponsorship to our registered bank account below, or donate online.

3.title: Receive Receipt & Updates
3.text: Share your transfer receipt on WhatsApp. You'll receive an official donation receipt, along with weekly and monthly progress updates with photos and videos.

items.q: What does PKR 30,000 a month cover?
items.a: It covers one child's complete monthly needs: Education (PKR 10,000), Food (PKR 9,000) and Home & Care (PKR 11,000) – including school, tuition, Quran classes, three meals a day, housing, utilities and the staff who look after the children.

items.q: Why are the Euro and Dollar amounts approximate?
items.a: Our sponsorship is set in Pakistani Rupees. Euro and Dollar values are shown for convenience and change with exchange rates, so the exact amount may differ slightly.

items.q: Can I sponsor more than one child?
items.a: Yes. Simply multiply the monthly amount by the number of children you wish to sponsor, and let us know on WhatsApp so we can confirm.

items.q: How do I make my monthly payment?
items.a: You can transfer to our registered bank account (details on this page) or use the online donation page. Please share your receipt with us on WhatsApp after each transfer.

items.q: Is Aasra Welfare Society a registered organization?
items.a: Yes. We are registered with the Government of Punjab, the Punjab Charity Commission and the FBR.
